bugs.error_message: go build with duckdb-go on Debian 11: undefined reference to std::__throw_bad_array_new_length() (hundreds), in libduckdb_static.a
bugs.root_cause: DuckDB's prebuilt static archive is built on manylinux with a newer GCC; it needs libstdc++ symbols from GCC 11+, and Debian 11 ships GCC 10. Same cause on Windows with Debian's MinGW (GCC 10, win32 threads): also undefined pthread_mutex_*.
bugs.fix: Do the final cgo link in a manylinux_2_28 image (build/Dockerfile.build). Rust archives may still be cross-compiled on Debian 11 (build/Dockerfile.cross).

bugs.error_message: apt-get install in debian:11 image fails with 404 on bullseye-security packages (exit 100)
bugs.root_cause: Debian 11 left the regular mirrors; packages are on archive.debian.org.
bugs.fix: Point sources.list at archive.debian.org and set Acquire::Check-Valid-Until false (build/Dockerfile.cross).

bugs.error_message: Lance search hits contain garbage in string fields (ID, RunID, Kind, Text); earlier: panic 'fixed-size list value count must equal list length times list size' on a chunk with no vector
bugs.root_cause: (1) arrow-go String.Value returns a string that aliases the Arrow buffer; buffers imported from lance-c through the C Data Interface are freed when the record batch is released, so the Go strings dangle. (2) FixedSizeListBuilder.AppendNull already appends the child slots; appending them again doubles the child length.
bugs.fix: strings.Clone every value read from an imported Arrow array before the batch is released; call only AppendNull for a null list.

bugs.error_message: sh: /usr/bin/time: No such file or directory (import container exit 127, docker wait reported 0)
bugs.root_cause: The manylinux link image has no /usr/bin/time, and the wrapper's last command was echo, so the container's exit code hid the failure.
bugs.fix: Time with date arithmetic, read peak memory from the cgroup, write the job's exit code into the result file and read that file.

bugs.error_message: perturb() advanced the text by the length of the replacement word, not the original
bugs.root_cause: The replaced word's length was used to slice the remaining text.
bugs.fix: Remember the consumed length before replacing the word.

bugs.error_message: WARNING: DATA RACE in run.(*Executor).Execute (go test -race ./internal/run)
bugs.root_cause: The runner's stdout and stderr are stored as blobs by two goroutines; both appended to the same refs slice and error list through the put and note closures.
bugs.fix: A mutex guards both appends.

bugs.error_message: TestStartRunsInOrder: runs of one `run start -n 3` listed in another order than queued
bugs.root_cause: Each run of a batch got its own random id (timestamp plus random suffix plus sequence number), so ids of the same second did not sort in queue order.
bugs.fix: One id stem per command; the runs differ only in the -NNN suffix.

bugs.error_message: A SKIPPED run showed SDK release 4.100.250 although no SDK release had been established
bugs.root_cause: Run.Harness was filled from the arm's named release at the start of Execute, before the lane image's label or the runner confirmed anything.
bugs.fix: Harness stays empty until the image label matches, and is then set from what the runner reports installed; the CLI prints 'not established' otherwise.

bugs.error_message: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'push') at recordProcessor (zod/v4/core/json-schema-processors.js:640) when a session of @cerebriline/sdk 4.100.250 builds its tool schemas
bugs.root_cause: The SDK is built and tested with zod 4.4.3 (its own lockfile) but publishes the range ^4.3.6; a fresh npm install resolved zod 4.6.7, whose JSON-schema internals (ctx.deferred) the SDK's bundle does not provide.
bugs.fix: npm overrides pin zod to 4.4.3 for @cerebriline/shared, core and llms; lockfile regenerated. Reported to the Cerebriline session.

bugs.error_message: Five real runs INVALID in 6 s: 'thinking.budget_tokens: the arm gives nothing, the session has 76800'
bugs.root_cause: With a reasoning effort stated and no budget, the SDK derives a thinking budget (xhigh gives 76800). compareResolved compared the absent arm field with the derived value and called it a difference. The stub arm leaves thinking to the tag, so the stub runs never reached this path.
bugs.fix: The budget is compared only when the arm states one; a derived budget is reported in the config_resolved note (derivedFromArm). Test added. No model was loaded by the five runs.

bugs.error_message: panic: nil pointer dereference in daemon.(*memState).Findings during go test ./internal/daemon
bugs.root_cause: the daemon now calls ingest after each run; the test store embeds store.State and did not implement Findings, ReplaceMetrics, ReplaceToolCalls, ReplaceFindings, Metrics
bugs.fix: implemented the methods on memState and added a test that a finished run is analysed and that reanalyse works

bugs.error_message: automaticum reanalyse --imported: 'the daemon does not answer' after 580 s; only part of the corpus analysed
bugs.root_cause: the reanalysis ran inside the HTTP request and used its context; the old corpus has event streams of up to 5 GB, so the caller gave up and the context was cancelled
bugs.fix: reanalysis is a job in the daemon (one at a time, four runs in parallel, own context); POST returns 202, GET /v1/reanalyse gives progress, the command only watches

bugs.error_message: DetectView redeclared in this block (internal/daemon/api.go)
bugs.root_cause: a scripted edit replaced the text between two markers assuming an order they did not have, duplicating two declarations
bugs.fix: removed the duplicate; check marker order before splicing

bugs.error_message: owner: the images should be sdk agnostic and support provisioning of a specific sdk version at runtime; multiple sdk versions at the same time; reproducible on demand
bugs.root_cause: the SDK was installed into the lane image and identified by an image label, so an image carried exactly one SDK and nothing kept the downloaded packages
bugs.fix: internal/sdk: one definition per build in runner/sdk/, bundle installed once and pinned by hash, packages archived, mounted read-only per run; images hold no SDK; sdk add/ls/verify

bugs.error_message: owner: why do you have to decide these numbers? based on what? ... you don't need to invent anything
bugs.root_cause: two detector thresholds (3 identical calls in a row; 10,000 characters as a runaway for every run) were set without data and carried as Open items with a recommendation to keep them, while the SDK's own guards hold measured thresholds for the same things
bugs.fix: detector library version 2: internal/detect/guards.go ports the SDK's reasoning repetition and reasoning loop guards with their thresholds; repeated_tool_call at 2 (info) and 5 (warning) as in the SDK; runaway only where a size is declared; D75

bugs.error_message: compare: tag parameters CHANGED BETWEEN RUNS for both arms of batch D81, although every value was the same
bugs.root_cause: the tag's parameters were hashed and compared as the server's raw text; xOllama 0.40.3-xollama.3 and .4 list the same parameters in a different order. Identity.Changed used the same raw comparison, so a reordering between the probes before and after a run could have made it INVALID
bugs.fix: run.ParametersKey (one parameter per line, sorted, single space) is what compare hashes and Identity.Changed compares; the recorded text stays the server's own; TestParametersKey

bugs.error_message: basis diff: detectors differ between the two D81 arms (model_reloaded 2 only in one run), though both were analysed with the same detectors
bugs.root_cause: the detectors fact was built from the versions on the findings a run had, so it said what fired, not what was applied
bugs.fix: ingest records metric analysis.version (ingest.AnalysisVersion) and keeps ingest.Versions; the basis names the analysis version and its detector versions

bugs.error_message: vet: undefined: resp / too many return values, after moving a handler's body into a function with a bulk regex replace
bugs.root_cause: the replace of fail(...)+return also rewrote the new wrapper's own decode error, and early returns used resp before its declaration; the same happened with compareView's reply
bugs.fix: declare the result at the top of the new function; check the wrapper by hand after a bulk replace; vet after each step

bugs.error_message: warning wire_arm stated, not sent: model.context_window = 32768, sent options.num_ctx as nothing (4 of 4 requests) on a mode C cell against an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
bugs.root_cause: CompareWire expected the arm's context window as options.num_ctx on every agent request; the OpenAI chat protocol has no per-request context field (llama-server holds it per slot)
bugs.fix: Request.OpenAI flag set for .../chat/completions; when every agent request is OpenAI-compatible the context window is not expected on the wire (mode C checks it against /props). wire_arm version 2, AnalysisVersion 2

bugs.error_message: cell warning: generation cap unverified: the server gave no finish reason for 1 of 12 requests (the request a steer cut)
bugs.root_cause: requests that got no answer (Failed: cut by the client or failed) were counted as finish.none, which the cap audit reads as 'the server left it unexplained'; CapHits already skipped failed requests
bugs.fix: count them as finish.failed; cap_hit version 2, AnalysisVersion 3; TestFailedRequestFinish

bugs.error_message: cell run --suite demo:cancel ran demo/cancel AND demo/scripted (2 tasks)
bugs.root_cause: the subset loop deleted each found id from the wanted set and tested len(want)==0 for 'no subset', so after the first match every later task of the suite matched
bugs.fix: decide 'whole suite' once before the loop; extracted cellTasks(all, suite, subset) with TestCellTasks

bugs.error_message: runner end outcome error: session not found: run-<id> (the completion rule's send after start() resolved)
bugs.root_cause: with interactive:false the SDK ends and disposes the session at 'ended'/'completed', so core.send() afterwards finds no session
bugs.fix: the session is interactive only when the script may continue it (a cancel or a completion rule), noted as runner line 'interactive'; the runner stops it explicitly at the end

bugs.error_message: demo/plan on the stub ended FAIL twice after a working plan->act switch: editor 'unavailable tool' in plan mode, then 'Read before editing: answer.txt has not been read in this session'
bugs.root_cause: the stub script ignored the arm's no-tool-call nudge (each text-only reply is answered once before a run ends), so its turns went out of step; and the read-before-edit guard forgets reads made in plan mode once the session is restarted in act mode
bugs.fix: stub script answers the nudge in both halves and reads again in act mode; the guard behaviour recorded in 040 §6.2 and asked of Cerebriline

bugs.error_message: demo/scripted verdict FAIL after the stage-2 denial moved to read_files
bugs.root_cause: with the only read denied, the arm's read-before-edit guard refuses the edit; the stub script never read again
bugs.fix: own stub script fix-scripted.json reads again after the denial (rule times = 1, so the second read is approved); verdict PASS

bugs.error_message: after a plan->act switch the editor was refused: 'Read before editing: … has not been read in this session'
bugs.root_cause: core makes a fresh read-receipt registry per session unless one is passed; the extension passes one registry for its controller's lifetime, the runner passed none
bugs.fix: ClineCore.create capabilities.readReceipts = sdk.createReadReceipts(), one per run; plan demo without a re-read now PASS

bugs.error_message: mode C cell with --endpoint-kind llamacpp: agent error 'Unknown or disabled provider "llamacpp".' before any chat request; verdict FAIL
bugs.root_cause: Arm.ForCell set model.provider to the endpoint kind; the SDK has no provider llamacpp (kind llamacpp is an OpenAI-compatible llama-server, 030 §3); cell_test asserted the wrong provider
bugs.fix: ProviderFor(kind): llamacpp -> openai-compatible; test corrected; the broken stub run invalidated with the reason; rerun PASS with every sampler field on the wire

bugs.error_message: docker: 400: client version 1.41 is too old. Minimum supported API version is 1.44, please upgrade your client to a newer version (sdk verify, image build on blackswan-2, Docker 29.1.3)
bugs.root_cause: The Engine API client pinned v1.41 in every URL; Docker 29.1 raised the engine's minimum API to 1.44 (linux-gpu-1's 29.8 still accepts 1.24 and up, so it never showed here)
bugs.fix: The client reads the engine's MinAPIVersion once from the unversioned /version and uses it when newer than v1.41 (pickVersion, TestPickVersion); a failed question is not cached

bugs.error_message: gate template: the tag does not offer tool calls (SKIPPED) on a llama-server-kind endpoint whose /props gives no chat_template_caps
bugs.root_cause: The new /props probe set Capabilities to [completion] when chat_template_caps was absent, so the gate read silence as 'no tools'
bugs.fix: Missing caps add 'template capabilities' to NotProbed and the gate says Unchecked; the stub's /props now reports caps like llama-server; tests for both

bugs.error_message: wire_arm: stated, not sent: thinking.effort = "high", sent think as nothing (OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the request carried reasoning_budget_tokens 48000)
bugs.root_cause: The wire_arm thinking check reads the Ollama 'think' field only; SDK 4.100.258's openai-compatible provider sends an effort as reasoning_budget_tokens and sends nothing for thinking on without an effort
bugs.fix: internal/ingest/wire.go maps an OpenAI request's reasoning_budget_tokens to options.think_budget_tokens; wire_arm (version 3) takes a positive budget on an OpenAI request as the arm's effort sent, and flags it as sent, not stated, when the tag owns thinking. Test TestOpenAIThinkingBudget.

bugs.error_message: the canary stopped the batch: <run 002>#2: ended by length; <run 002>#3: ended by length (on resume, after runs 001 and 002 had been marked INVALID)
bugs.root_cause: The canary judges the batch's first requests whatever became of their runs; requests of runs an operator later marked INVALID (here: the base model served by mistake) still count, so a resumed batch is stopped on evidence already set aside
bugs.fix: OPEN: worked around by a fresh batch (b20261023-114320-60b8e5) and run 003 marked INVALID with the reason. The canary should leave out requests of runs marked INVALID and judge the next ones

bugs.error_message: latent: automaticum detect on a run with guard trips would panic (assignment to entry in nil map)
bugs.root_cause: internal/daemon/api.go builds ingest.Events{Notices: ...} without GuardTrips, then Events.Read increments ev.GuardTrips for a guard_trip note
bugs.fix: Events.Read creates Notices, GuardTrips and GuardCauses when they are nil; TestGuardTrips reads into a bare Events

bugs.error_message: gcc: /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.38' not found (cpp lane layer copying gcc:14 onto the base)
bugs.root_cause: The pinned gcc:14 image is Debian 13 (glibc 2.41); the lane base is node on Debian 12 (glibc 2.36), so GCC 14 and its libstdc++ in /usr/local/lib64 cannot run there
bugs.fix: The cpp layer starts FROM the gcc image and copies Node, npm, the runner from automaticum-lane:base, reinstalls the base's apt tools and creates the node user (1000:1000)

bugs.error_message: task: tasks/train-game/space_invaders/task.toml: fixture seed: no files
bugs.root_cause: validate refused any [[fixture]] without files, though Verify lays fixture files over the prepared seed, so an empty fixture is exactly the seed; all 17 training tasks from backup_models declare the seed fixture that way
bugs.fix: A fixture with no files is allowed when expect = "fail" (the seed); refused for expect = "pass". TestSeedFixture; 060 §3

bugs.error_message: no way to override a task's wall limit: the arm can only lower it (backup_models: TIMEOUT retries at 50 min impossible); run start takes one task only
bugs.root_cause: run.go took lower(arm, task) for wall and idle with no batch-level override; the CLI's -task was a single string though StartRequest.Tasks existed
bugs.fix: run.Override (Request.Limits) replaces both, owner "batch"; StartRequest.Limits, control.Limits, POST /v1/batches/{b}/limits, run start --wall-s/--idle-s, batch limits; campaign wall_s/idle_s/suites/capture_requests; basis names a batch limit; --task repeatable, --suite, StartRequest.Suites, StartResponse.Images. Tests TestBatchLimits, TestBatchLimitsOverride, TestBasisBatchLimits, TestStartSuites, TestLoadCampaign

bugs.error_message: Mail 1879: arm g4-128e-bf16-c13-shipped says stop_on = [] ('no trip ends the run') but 5 pool runs end agent_end=aborted after the SDK's 'Ending the run after 3 turns cut for this'
bugs.root_cause: The SDK's reasoning-loop guard has its own end-of-run rule: reasoningLoopDetection.maxConsecutiveTrips (default 3, consecutive cut turns; a clean turn resets the streak), and the host may answer onReasoningLoopLimitReached with {action:'continue'}. The runner passes reasoningLoopDetection: {} (the SDK's own numbers) and no hook, so automaticum's stop_on never sees that decision.
bugs.fix: D108 (owner, 2026-10-25): arm states guards.reasoning_loop.max_consecutive_trips (base 3); runner answers onReasoningLoopLimitReached from stop_on (protocol 8); limitBreach makes a run INVALID when the SDK ends it against the arm. SDK core must forward the hook (X9, asked).

bugs.error_message: TestSpansShortUnit: spans [{9 45}], want [{10 46}]
bugs.root_cause: The test assumed the unit 'abc ' but the short-unit detector takes the leftmost repeating unit, ' abc' from the space after 'intro'.
bugs.fix: Test expectation corrected; Spans was right.

bugs.error_message: TestCampaign (internal/daemon) failed once under make test: a run of batch k-c1-second has Campaign "" (want c1); passes 5/5 on rerun
bugs.root_cause: Not found yet: likely a race between the run record being written and the campaign name being attached (pre-existing; seen while testing the export layout, which does not touch campaigns)
bugs.fix: OPEN: not fixed; rerun passed
